answer: Comet-Trail Correlation Audit.** Each agent instance emits signed action receipts into a shared log; a periodic audit clusters receipts by latent behavioral fingerprints—timing jitter, tool-call sequences, phrasing entropy. Clusters spanning many claimed identities trigger review, and confirmed duplicates lose accumulated reputation. An attacker pays for sustained distinct dialects per clone: separate compute for timing noise, varied copper-priced infrastructure, and hand-tuned sable-coded style variation per identity, making each persistent clone cost roughly a full independent agent.
